title: What Is Polymorphism?
instructions: What does polymorphism mean in programming?

options.text: A class can only have one method
Treating objects of different types through a common interface or parent type
Using only interfaces instead of classes

explanation: Polymorphism means "many forms." It allows you to write code that works with a parent type or interface, and the correct method runs automatically based on the actual type of each object. This makes code flexible and reusable.
